summary: Users reported that a platform called Vinance promoted through a community group presented fake trades fake IEO offerings and a fake payment partner while encouraging large deposits and loans. Withdrawal attempts failed and the platform and associated contacts were described as fraudulent.
user_mistake: depositing funds into an unverified investment platform promoted through online groups
prevention: Independently verify platform registration and licensing before investing and refuse any trading platform that pressures you to deposit more funds or take loans
